inspiration.observed_pattern: An existing foreign-key constraint is dropped and recreated with a different ON DELETE action.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reduced to one independently authored parcel and one nullable item. Dropping RESTRICT and adding SET NULL isolates the constraint replacement before deleting the parent.

fixture_notes: The single item initially references the parcel under RESTRICT; after replacement, deleting the parcel must preserve the item with a NULL reference.
determinism_notes: The one fixed parent and child use deterministic IDs; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE parcel_min (parcel_id INT PRIMARY KEY)
CREATE TABLE item_min (item_id INT PRIMARY KEY, parcel_id INT NULL, CONSTRAINT fk_item_min_parcel FOREIGN KEY (parcel_id) REFERENCES parcel_min (parcel_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT)

steps.sql: ALTER TABLE item_min DROP FOREIGN KEY fk_item_min_parcel
ALTER TABLE item_min ADD CONSTRAINT fk_item_min_parcel FOREIGN KEY (parcel_id) REFERENCES parcel_min (parcel_id) ON DELETE SET NULL

checks.sql: SELECT parcel_id FROM parcel_min ORDER BY parcel_id
SELECT item_id, parcel_id FROM item_min ORDER BY item_id
